name: cloudvault
description: A web file manager for any S3-compatible storage.

scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install && cd api && uv sync
scripts.dev:api: cd api && uv run python -m app --reload
scripts.start: cd api && uv run python -m app --serve-web
scripts.format: prettier --write --ignore-path .gitignore --ignore-path .prettierignore --ignore-path .git/info/exclude . && cd api && uv run ruff check --fix && uv run ruff format
scripts.lint: prettier --check --ignore-path .gitignore --ignore-path .prettierignore --ignore-path .git/info/exclude . && pnpm --filter @cloudvault/web lint && cd api && uv run ruff check && uv run ruff format --check
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @cloudvault/web test && cd api && uv run pytest
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
